repair_summary.finding: 1 (critical) - fixture roots and reads are not confined
repair_summary.resolution: backend.py now requires the resolved fixture root to carry the explicit '.a5_1-fixture-root' marker with exact bytes; any root whose resolved path contains a 'studies' or 'restricted' component is refused with UNAUTHORISED_FIXTURE_ROOT before any file is opened; a new _safe_path() rejects a symlink component or a resolved-path escape for every corpus/recorded read, and corpus/ and recorded/ must themselves be real directories. New reason code UNAUTHORISED_FIXTURE_ROOT with fixed human-action text. Adversarial coverage: tests/a5_1/test_fixture_root_confinement.py (bare/markerless root, tampered marker, studies/S001_airport_cw-named root, knowledge/restricted-named root, symlinked corpus file, symlinked recorded/ dir, '..' in source_file, nominal root still authorised, intake returns a structured unresolved outcome and never raises).

repair_summary.finding: 2 (high) - recorded request integrity declared but not enforced
repair_summary.resolution: resolve() now calls _verify_recorded_request(): it reads recorded/<id>.request.json, requires sha256(bytes) == meta.request_sha256, requires the bytes to parse as ProposalRequest and to already be canonical, and requires byte-equality with canonical_bytes(incoming request). Runs after the source-digest check so SOURCE_DIGEST_MISMATCH / version mismatches keep their specific codes. Coverage: tests/a5_1/test_fixture_integrity.py::RecordedRequestIntegrityTest (meta.request_sha256 replaced with 64x'a', flipped recorded-request byte, non-canonical recorded request, intake never raises).

repair_summary.finding: 3 (high) - malformed fixture metadata can escape the structured failure contract
repair_summary.resolution: backend.py adds a strict typed _FixtureMeta pydantic model (extra='forbid', frozen, strict=True) with per-field patterns/bounds for fixture_id, kind, the three versions, source_id, source_file, source_sha256, source_byte_length, request_sha256, output_sha256. _load_meta validates the parsed JSON against it and converts any ValidationError (wrong type, bad pattern, unknown key, missing key) into ProposalError(MALFORMED_FIXTURE_RECORD, <content-free ref>). The former bare-dict lookups are gone. Coverage: tests/a5_1/test_fixture_integrity.py::StrictMetadataContractTest iterates every field with wrong-typed/out-of-contract values (incl. the list-valued source_id from the finding) plus unknown-key and missing-key cases, asserting a structured failure and that run_proposal_intake never raises.

repair_summary.finding: 4 (high) - ambiguous source provenance identity and a proposed claim without a stable id
repair_summary.resolution: contracts.py PackageProvenance now rejects duplicate source_id. backend._load_package enforces a one-to-one match: the recorded package must declare exactly the single source the backend verified (len==1, same source_id, same sha256 and byte_length), otherwise MALFORMED_FIXTURE_RECORD ('fixture.package.sources'). ProposedModelHypothesis gains a stable 'ref' identifier constrained to 'PM-NNN' when present and required to be empty when absent; ProposalPackage cross-checks now key the hypothesis citation-owner on that ref. cw-basics fixture proposes PM-001. Coverage: test_contracts.py (duplicate-source rejection, PM ref pattern, absent-must-stay-empty, present-needs-ref), test_proposal_shape.py (present ref matches PM-NNN, absent ref empty), test_fixture_integrity.py::OneToOneSourceProvenanceTest (duplicate entry, extra distinct entry, package not declaring the verified source).

assumptions: Base commit 21781d0 is the reviewed Phase A baseline named in the task brief; git CLI is unusable in this sandbox (unreadable ~/.gitconfig, .git outside the readable path), so Codex must confirm the base SHA and full diff independently.

'Explicitly authorised fixture root' (finding 1) is implemented as a checked-in marker file 'tests/fixtures/a5_1/.a5_1-fixture-root' whose bytes are canonical_json({'a5_1_recorded_fixture_root': true, 'contract_version': 'a5.1.0'}). The backend stays generic over a root argument (no production fixture root is shipped in src/), but it now refuses any root without that exact marker, plus any root whose resolved path contains a 'studies' or 'restricted' component. build_fixtures.py generates the marker so regeneration stays the source of truth.

Digest semantics are unchanged: source digest = SHA-256 of raw on-disk source bytes; request digest = SHA-256 of canonical request DTO bytes; output digest = SHA-256 of canonical proposal-package DTO bytes (package alone). meta.request_sha256 is now load-bearing: it must equal SHA-256 of the adjacent recorded request file, whose bytes must also be canonical and equal the incoming request.

proposed_model_hypothesis remains a single always-present section object; it now also carries a stable 'ref' ('PM-NNN' when present, '' when absent) so it has the same kind of identifier as the PS-/PR-/MI-/SF-/IF- items.
_FixtureMeta uses pydantic strict mode so a JSON bool/'5'/list never coerces into a str or int field; every metadata defect is a ValidationError mapped to MALFORMED_FIXTURE_RECORD.

New ReasonCode UNAUTHORISED_FIXTURE_ROOT is additive; REASON_HUMAN_ACTION carries fixed content-free guidance for it and run_proposal_intake maps it to a typed unresolved item like every other structured failure.
limitations: The recorded backend still demonstrates only the interface and trust contract (request/response/provenance shape, digest/version discipline, fixture-root confinement, recorded-request integrity, strict metadata typing, one-to-one source provenance, proposal-only authority, structured unresolved states, byte stability, privacy). It says nothing about model quality, numerical/physics correctness, standards applicability, or engineering/review status.

_safe_path relies on the fixture-id and source-file regexes (no '..', no separators) plus per-component is_symlink() checks and a post-resolution containment assertion; the authorised root itself is canonicalised with Path.resolve() before any child path is formed. It does not attempt to defend against a root directory being swapped for a symlink between resolve() calls (TOCTOU) - each resolve() re-canonicalises from scratch.

The network guard still patches high-level Python entry points only (socket.socket.connect/connect_ex, socket.create_connection/getaddrinfo/gethostbyname/socketpair, subprocess.Popen); the static-import scan of src/noam/proposals and the absence of any client dependency remain the complementary evidence. backend.py adds no new imports beyond json, re, pathlib, typing and pydantic.
Fixture corpus is unchanged purpose-written synthetic text (CC0-1.0). 'malformed-record' and 'digest-drift' stay deliberately broken; build_fixtures.py --check treats them as expected.

--release and the unknown-mode branch of scripts/verify.sh were not re-executed this round because the non-interactive sandbox declined those invocations; scripts/verify.sh is byte-identical to the previously reviewed candidate and those branches were not touched.
